bio.text: Eva-Dina Delgado is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 3rd District, based in Chicago.
According to her Illinois House Democrats biography, she holds a J.D. from the DePaul University College of Law and a B.A. in international relations from Wellesley College.
The biography lists service on the Chicago Police Board from 2016 to 2019 and says she lives in Chicago's Logan Square neighborhood with her husband and daughter.
